definitions.gloss: enjoying the evening cool; cooling off in the evening
definitions.explanation: The practice of going outside or sitting on a veranda in the evening to enjoy the cool air after a hot summer day. A quintessentially Japanese summer custom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{夕涼|ゆうすず}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy the evening cool on the veranda.

examples.japanese: {夕涼|ゆうすず}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{川沿|かわぞ}い→川沿い：03046_kawazoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk along the river to enjoy the evening cool.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧{夕涼|ゆうすず}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧。
examples.english: The sight of neighbors gathering to enjoy the evening cool on summer evenings is nostalgic.

notes:
USAGE: {夕涼|ゆうすず}み is a summer seasonal word (⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧) in haiku and is strongly associated with traditional Japanese summer life. The custom involves sitting outside, fanning oneself, eating watermelon, and watching fireworks or fireflies.

With the spread of air conditioning, {夕涼|ゆうすず}み as a daily practice has become less common but remains culturally evocative.

- {夕涼|ゆうすず}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to enjoy the evening cool
- {夕涼|ゆうすず}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out for the evening cool
- ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{夕涼|ゆうすず}み: cooling off on the veranda
